I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092.

That comes from Ilse Varga's message in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because it resets the Polycom.
